finding: Pending enquiry fields can diverge from submitted data
repro: Submit the intercepted fixture and edit the name while the request is held.
baseline: The visible form accepts a different name while the captured request contains the previous name. Reopening can display the edited values for an already-sending request.
change: Every form control is frozen with its context until completion. Previous disabled states and all entered data are restored after failure.

finding: Pending close/reopen leaves the error below view
repro: At 390×600 close/reopen an intercepted pending enquiry, then return 503 or 422.
baseline: The failed request preserves data but its error is not fully visible in the current scroll position.
change: After restoring controls the dialog focuses/scrolls the first server-invalid field or the live message.

finding: Catalogue state disagrees with browser history
repro: Home → Plans → bedrooms 2, area under 300, Interior → Back → Forward; reload the explicit query URL.
baseline: Back changes the URL to / but leaves the previous selects, preview and empty result.
change: Initial load, popstate and pageshow restore recognized query values, count, empty state, preview and residence links without rewriting history.

finding: View floor plan does not target the floor plan
repro: Select Interior in the homepage collection, then activate View floor plan.
baseline: The detail opens at its top with photographs; the requested plan is below the mobile fold.
change: The CTA preserves the collection query and targets #floor-plan on the detail page. The plan and Enlarge control are visible on arrival.

finding: Failed gallery navigation gives no explanation or retry
repro: Fail the next image in Highlights or Interiors and activate Next.
baseline: The previous frame/counter remain with no explanation or retry.
change: Both galleries retain the good frame, provide loading/error/retry feedback and preserve latest intent through failure/recovery.

finding: Small header emblem differs from the primary source
repro: Compare the eight-bar emblem with Figma 2029:881.
baseline: Rounded dimensions and offsets make a 25×20 shape instead of the authored 25×19.2857 geometry.
change: The original eight rectangles use the source dimensions, offsets and currentColor. Header/footer wordmark assets remain the original source masks.

repro: Open the enquiry or navigation dialog and hover its Close icon or a navigation label.
baseline: The shared light gold #b39985 on cream #fef8f4 measures 2.553:1.
change: Only these interactive hover colors use the existing darker brown #72614f, measuring 5.638:1. Decorative gold remains unchanged.
